summary: A generative firmware that writes a four-piece band sketch (drums, bass, keys, lead) from a map of 16 genre towns, which you then re-roll, edit and perform. Version 0.4 is experimental and only partly tested on hardware.
features: Map of 16 genre towns; points between towns blend two genres
Re-roll or audition band members; Jam mode morphs and tours the map
Step grid editing, live recording and TAP rhythm entry
Perform page turns the 27 keys into effects, with build and drop
Six-letter codes rebuild a sketch; four save slots that can chain
Shares and overwrites SLOOP's project slots; no user samples

headings: what it does to data already on the fm-1
